summary: Defines the cite-as link relation type, which lets a resource convey a preferred URI for referencing it. This helps when the URI used to access a resource is not the one that should be cited. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A link that says 'if you want to mention this page, please use this address instead', like a book telling you the proper way to cite it.

questions: how to indicate a canonical citation link
